newsitem.title: USA: USDA sets Aug 1 deadline for first pork bids.
newsitem.headline: USDA sets Aug 1 deadline for first pork bids.

text.p: The Agriculture Department said Friday it would begin buying frozen pork for the national school lunch and other food programs, with the first bids due by August 1.
The USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service said it would announce which offers were accepted by August 8, for shipment in September.
Offers for coarse ground pork are due by August 8, with acceptances to be announced on August 15, also for delivery in September.
Purchases will be made on a bi-weekly basis until all requirements are met, the USDA said.
